column1: # Layer 1 — instrument validity, one record per row. Schema for INSTRUMENT.md.
# Validity is per reading, keyed to instrument_id/axis/regime/readout/artifact_set — never global.
# Each check is a separate fact; instrument_valid is their conjunction, carried beside them.
# A failed check -> the keyed reading is `unresolved` with the failed check named (see readings.tsv).
# Boolean fields: 1 = holds, 0 = fails. control_streams names the streams that must match.
